predecessors.name: Kingdom of France
predecessors.text: the county of Artois, given as an apanage to Robert on his majority in 1237 under the will of his father Louis VIII

successors.name: Free County of Burgundy
successors.text: Artois, left in 1330 by Joan II to Joan III with Franche-Comté, who married Odo IV of Burgundy that year

ledger.x: 1237: Robert I becomes Count of Artois.
1329: Mahaut dies and Artois passes to her daughter Joan II.
1330: Joan III marries Odo IV of Burgundy.
1332: last year of the Cliopatria Artois row; its cells pass to the Free County of Burgundy row in 1333.

wars.name: Franco-Flemish campaigns of Robert II of Artois
wars.outcome: Robert II beat the Flemings at the Battle of Furnes in 1297 and was killed near Kortrijk on 11 July 1302 when his cavalry charge failed on marshy ground; the Treaty of Athis-sur-Orge (23 June 1305) gave Lille, Douai and Orchies to the French crown.

certainty.note: A feudal apanage bounded by Flanders, Boulogne, Ponthieu and Vermandois; no treaty line before 1332 is on the pages (the Treaty of Athis-sur-Orge of 1305 does not mention Artois).
